checkpoints.description: [1/5] Plan Tessera: pure seamless-pattern engine, static browser studio, SVG export, tests, and an embed contract for the AegeanWorks site

impact_assessment.why: The user wants a new static showcase project for the website, like Prism-Relay but not necessarily a game; a zero-dependency pattern studio is instantly visible, interactive and useful without a backend.
impact_assessment.benefits: A polished, offline-capable browser demo with deterministic pattern generation, crisp SVG export, accessible controls, and a commit-versioned build the website can embed.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new standalone project plus a website-ready static layout; dependency: none beyond Node 20 for tests and tooling; concurrency: the AegeanWorks playable-weft work is uncommitted and must not be overwritten; state: localStorage preferences and URL parameters.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Build and test the pure engine first, keep runtime files under index.html and src/**, avoid touching the website repo while its playable task is uncommitted, and run the project gates before delivery.

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Pure export-size table and PNG filename module; DOM-free raster orchestrator with injected canvas/image adapters; failing-first tests

impact_assessment.why: Tessera can export only 1600x1067 SVG; a pattern studio needs wallpaper and phone PNGs without a screenshot tool, and users cannot use the exported art as a wallpaper today.
impact_assessment.benefits: One click produces a crisp PNG at a stated size from the same seamless tile; sizes and filenames are data, so the raster path is testable in Node and stays independent of DOM code.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new studio/export.js and studio/raster.js modules plus a new sidebar control; dependency: none (Canvas/Blob browser APIs, no new packages); concurrency: none, read-only state; state: no change to the versioned localStorage record or URL schema.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep raster.js free of DOM globals by injecting createCanvas/loadImage from app.js; validate dimensions against a 16.7 MP ceiling; failing-first tests for sizes, naming, draw calls and failure paths; static contract stays green.

checkpoints.description: [3/3] PNG export shipped: frozen wallpaper/Full HD/4K/phone/square size table, DOM-free raster orchestrator with injected canvas/image adapters, sidebar export block with P shortcut, README and ADR-006, v0.2.0. 85 Node tests in budget, 4/4 project gates, static contract; Edge headless produced 1080x1080 and 3840x2160 PNGs plus the createImageBitmap fallback with zero console errors; no overflow at 320/390/768/1024/1440/1920 and the 768px two-column grid pairs cleanly. checklists: passed

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Pure gallery model (visual signature, add/remove/restore, 12-entry cap); versioned localStorage record with corrupt-safe loading; failing-first tests

impact_assessment.why: Every look is ephemeral unless the URL is kept: there is no way to save a few candidates, compare them, or return to one after a reload, and sharing requires selecting the address bar. A local gallery makes the studio useful across sessions without accounts or a backend.
impact_assessment.benefits: Up to 12 looks survive reloads and can be restored in one click; duplicates collapse by visual signature; a Copy link action shares the exact current state; corrupt or unsupported records never break the studio.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new gallery.js, storage record and sidebar block; dependency: none (localStorage only); concurrency: one record written on explicit save/delete; state: new tessera.gallery.v1 key, studio state and URL schema untouched.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the model pure and the storage boundary in storage.js; cap and dedupe in the model; preserve guides/motion on restore like presets; failing-first tests for cap, dedupe, version refusal, corruption and hostile stores; browser e2e for save, reload, restore and delete.

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Local gallery shipped: pure signature/dedupe/12-cap model, versioned tessera.gallery.v1 record, sidebar Save look (S), Copy link (L), thumbnail restore and delete, README and ADR-007, v0.3.0. 96 Node tests in budget, 4/4 project gates, static contract; headless Edge verified save, reload, restore, delete, duplicate-save collapse and clipboard share link with zero console errors; no overflow at 320/390/768/1024/1440/1920 and the 768px grid spans the seventh block. checklists: passed

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Add rotate (0/90/180/270) and flip (none/x/y) to the state contract; [2/3] apply them inside the SVG pattern with tile-dimension swaps for quarter turns, wire the Geometry controls, gallery and export names; [3/3] document ADR-008 and verify every motif/transform combination

impact_assessment.why: Every motif always faces the same way, and transforming the stage or the exported canvas would crop the repeat or break the rectangular Comb tile. The studio needs more variation without giving up the seamless-by-construction guarantee.
impact_assessment.benefits: Four rotations and three mirror states multiply the palette without a second drawing path; transforms travel in the URL, the local gallery and both export formats; old links and records still load at 0/none.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: state schema gains optional rotate/flip fields and export filenames gain an r90-fx suffix; dependency: none; concurrency: none, one writer per state record; state: gallery version stays 1 because the fields are optional, and existing entries normalize to 0/none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Normalize enumerated values, preserve transforms across presets, swap tile dimensions at 90/270, test every motif/rotation/flip combination for finite geometry, and verify the browser stage, PNG export, gallery round-trip and responsive layout.

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Tile transforms shipped: rotate 0/90/180/270 and flip none/x/y in the state contract, SVG pattern transform with dimension swap for quarter turns, Geometry selects, gallery and export-name integration, README and ADR-008, v0.4.0. 100 Node tests in budget, 4/4 project gates, static contract; headless Edge verified a 90° mirrored comb, 270° change, stage description, 1080 PNG export, gallery save/reload and zero console errors; no overflow at 320/390/768/1024/1440/1920. checklists: passed
